reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: the MSA engages Contractor 'on a task by task basis' under separately negotiated SOWs with time-and-materials compensation and no minimum volume, requirements or sole-source commitment.

No exclusivity language binds the Customer; the only 'exclusive' references identified are Contractor's retained pre-existing IP, a non-exclusive license in our favor (which benefits us), and the entire-agreement clause — none restrict our freedom to buy elsewhere.
Redline is unchanged and no comment is proposed, which is correct for a compliant finding; deterministic check confirms no residual sole-supplier obligation.
Rationale correctly avoids double-flagging the mutual employee non-solicitation, which is a personnel restriction handled under a separate rule.
